description: Form-finding artifacts - equilibrium as an approached limit.

settling_tremble.description: The form-finding seam. A hanging chain finds an exact equilibrium - the catenary. A solver cannot reach it; it relaxes step by step and stops when the largest move drops below a tolerance, epsilon. So the 'settled' shape trembles inside a band someone chose. Amber: the true catenary. Blue: the relaxed nodes, each a hair off. The inset magnifies it - zoom the settled form and it still shivers. Settled means tired, not still.
settling_tremble.name: Settling Tremble
settling_tremble.qfep_connection: A station in the bias landscape (doc/SEAM_PER_SEQUENCE.md); the digital-bias seam for formfinding. Bias is conserved; show the seam.
